description: Get the text of an article of a Korean law in force, verbatim and unedited from the Ministry of Government Legislation (법제처). The law needs its official name, in Korean or the official English title (e.g. 근로기준법, Labor Standards Act). With lang en (default for an English law name) it gives the official English translation, a notice on whether that translation matches the Korean version in force, and the legally binding Korean original. edition 시행예정 gives the article of a promulgated amendment not yet in force (check whether one exists with get_law_status).

article.description: Article number. E.g. 36, 제36조, 제6조의2, Article 76-2

branch.description: Branch number (the 2 in 제6조의2, Article 6-2). Omit if already in article

edition.description: 현행 = in force (default) / 시행예정 = promulgated but not yet in force

lang.description: Answer language. en: official English translation + version check + Korean original / ko: Korean. Default: en if the law name is English

law.description: Official law name in Korean or English. E.g. 근로기준법, 주택임대차보호법 시행령, Labor Standards Act

name: get_article
title: Get law article (조문 원문)
